eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 5:23 AM on AUG 31, 2021 Effective until 3:23 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa and Pinal counties. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office is looking for Jeannine Fautsch, a white female, 87 years of age. Jeannine is believed to be on-foot, and was reported missing from area of the 9200 block of East Fairway Blvd, in Sun Lakes, at 3:45pm on August 30th. She is approximately 5 feet, 2 inches tall, and 115 pounds. Jeannine suffers from a condition that may make her lost and disoriented. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
